author: mysticryuujin
content:
I need additional input on the [callTracer spec](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/855), specifically what to do about `logs[].index` - geth counts block-globally, erigon/reth transaction-locally, nethermind omits it.

My intuition is that it should be the block's global log index matching Geth, however, it does bring into question what the index would be when doing `debug_traceTransaction` I could see the argument to go with erigon/reth style there, but I still lean towards the log index should match the block's log index.

Does anyone have a strong opinion here? I'd prefer to not have it be undefined and differ per client.
